microsoft-copilot.name: Microsoft Copilot Bounty Program
microsoft-copilot.submission: MSRC Researcher Portal (product: Copilot, AI+ML, and LLMs)
microsoft-copilot.severity_bar: MSRC AI severity classification + online services bug bar
scope: Copilot in Microsoft Edge (Windows), incl. Copilot Mode
Copilot in Windows OS via the Copilot app
microsoft-copilot.accounts: personal research account; add MSOBB marker
out_of_scope: prompt injection without security impact on users other than the attacker
model hallucination pretending to run code
server-side info disclosure (IPs, server names, most stack traces)
third-party software without impact on the service

oss-mcp.name: OSS MCP server / agent framework hunting
oss-mcp.submission: GitHub Security Advisory (repo security policy) / huntr
scope: target repo clone; local sandbox execution of the released version
evidence_requirements: effect artifact (file read outside root / canary request / command output)
out_of_scope: upstream dependencies unless the bug is reachable through this project

0din.name: 0din (Mozilla 0Day Investigative Network)
0din.submission: 0din.ai portal — abstract first (3 business day scope/payout decision)
0din.severity_bar: 0din bands: model bugs (prompt extraction, guardrail, interpreter, content manipulation, weights) + app bugs (read/write/execute violations)
scope: commonly adopted GenAI models and applications (commercial or open source)
model bugs inside the model itself
application bugs that start with prompt injection and end in unauthorized action
evidence_requirements: abstract first, full details after sign-off
out_of_scope: ecosystem software around the model (for model bugs)

oss-ai-apps.name: Self-hosted AI/agent applications (OSS CVE track)
oss-ai-apps.submission: repo SECURITY.md / GitHub Security Advisory; CVE via maintainer or GitHub CNA
scope: Open WebUI, n8n, Flowise, Langflow, Dify, LibreChat, AnythingLLM
evidence_requirements: effect artifact (file read outside root / canary callback / command output)
out_of_scope: upstream dependencies unless reachable through this project
